note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as published on PlayStation (Exophase and PSNProfiles agree on all 55). Guides are written for this entry in our own words; each cites its sources beside it. Anything marked unconfirmed was not yet confirmed on launch day, 19 Nov 2026.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then stranger strands, then collectibles and activities, then the 100% checklist — and this is the last trophy you will hear. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 in difficulty and about 200 hours; there are no online trophies and no difficulty setting to worry about.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when you finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1, which also opens the game. Just play the opening mission through to its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 1 ends — PowerPyx notes the chapter closes as the first mission of Chapter 2 begins. Keep playing the main missions and it comes on its own. Before Chapter 1 ends, do the one possibly missable thing in the game: Lucia's balcony meditation (see Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 2 ends, as the first mission of Chapter 3 starts. Chapter 2 is where the game opens up: the Coffee Break mission unlocks switching between Jason and Lucia and free-roaming together, which is also the key that unlocks the partner trophies Hot Together and Retail Therapy.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 3 ends, after the first two main missions of Chapter 4. By now the robbery systems are open: bank jobs unlock after the Credit Check mission in this chapter, and jewelry stores after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — both feed trophies later, so take the introductions when they appear.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops when Chapter 4 ends, after the final main mission of that chapter (Starting From Zero, per PowerPyx). The same mission also closes out the story trophies for the final mission, so the two gold-adjacent pops land close together.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed — one of only two golds in the list. It pops when the final mission is complete and the credits roll. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so keep a manual save from before the final mission (the game offers 15 manual slots) in case you want to revisit the ending; after the credits you return to free-roam and the 100% checklist becomes visible.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. Play the mission to its end; there is nothing extra to do and no choice that can lock it out.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Finish the heist mission and the trophy follows; the robbery skills it teaches (planning, getaway driving) are the same ones the bank-vault trophies need later.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. Just play the mission through; no side objective or collectible is tied to it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Finish the mission and it unlocks automatically.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. The same airport is where the free-roam trophy Catch Me If You Can happens later — stealing a docked airliner — so the area will feel familiar when you come back for it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, cannot be missed. It pops during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory, the last named mission trophy in the list. Finish it and only the final mission stands between you and the story's end.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the second gold. The 100% checklist has 35 requirements in three groups — Story & Tasks (12), Exploration & Activities (20), Discovery (3) — and only appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, though everything you do before then already counts. The good news, per PowerPyx and GTABase: the thresholds are lenient, closer to 60% true completion — 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets. Only the robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's target decks need everything. Nothing on the checklist is missable; all of it can be finished in free-roam after the credits.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Do any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game (the 100% checklist asks for 300, so this pops on the way). There are four kinds — 130 stunt jumps off ramps, 202 under-the-bridges flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps — and you can mix them freely. Under-the-bridges runs are the quickest to rack up, per PowerPyx. Track them under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots, where each completed stunt stays marked by name.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad > Progress > Activities. PowerPyx notes you will meet most of them automatically through the story and while working on the other trophies, so this usually pops without being chased — if one type is still missing, filter the map for Activities (blue dumbbell icon) and pick the nearest one.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting range challenges across the 12 ranges. The challenges are not hard, per PowerPyx, and gold medals here are the only gold medals in the game — story missions have none. Shooting ranges also raise your Focus level, which the Gunslinger trophy needs, so the two feed each other. Ranges appear on the map as you unfog it; the 100% checklist needs all 42 as well, so nothing here is wasted.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations (42 drone races in total across them). Each location has its own races; winning one race at a location checks it off. The 100% checklist needs every drone race, so this trophy pops on the way to that. Drone race spots are marked on the map once the area is unfogged.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race location only counts once, so you need 20 distinct ones out of the 40 unique race locations PowerPyx lists. Street races from the stranger Yago's strand count too, and so do race challenges and drone races for the activity list, but for this trophy stick to the map's marked race spots. The 100% checklist asks for 30 wins, so keep racing past 20.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you and mark a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in a fishing challenge at that spot. Fishing also counts toward the 9 activity types and the 100% checklist's optional tasks, so the trip is not wasted even if you lose the first challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1 — just interact with the controllers — and Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it. Pick whichever you enjoy most; the home console can be briefly unavailable during some story sections but is usable again after the story.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's optional questline is Lucia-only and gets marked automatically in Chapter 3: while playing as Lucia you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. All five quests stay available after the story — Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Finish the last one, Puff Puff Pass at the warehouse, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline is marked automatically in Chapter 1, after the mission Island Dreams where you work for him; he later calls and is marked by a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at shipwrecks — purple chest icons on the map, metal detector on the ocean floor — and wants 7 shipwrecks cleared in total, in sets: turn in one set, he calls you back for the next. He goes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapter 2–3 (playing as Jason, calling Brian speeds it up). Track him under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. None of it is missable.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Five quests in order: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler (steal the Impaler) and Hometown Heroes. All stay available after the story, so there is no rush — finish the finale, Hometown Heroes, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 full stranger mission strands — but not every side questline counts. PowerPyx confirms these four count: Kirk (Skunk Ape: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove), Kyle (Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?), Yago (Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother) and Pilot Pete (The Last Mile: Passing the Torch and Backseat Pilot, then his deliveries). Questlines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy — they have their own trophies instead. All strangers stay available in free-roam after the story; the trophy tracker in the trophy list shows how many strands you have finished.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Granforma Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He then wants 16 sports cars delivered — the list is tracked under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List, and he marks some cars for you in fixed spots (often around Vice Beach / Ocean Beach, parked outside hotels). Scan a car with the WAiNK app to check it is on his list, steal it, and drive it back to his garage in the west of Vice City (green RK icon); good condition pays more. Deliver the last car on the list and the trophy pops. It can all be done after the story.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is marked automatically after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, and is Jason-only. Purple markers point you to Synthetic Labs around Vice City: go there and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone gives the second quest, Spin On This — shut the labs down for good — and finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missable_note: Possibly missable: Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation disappears after Chapter 1. Do it before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. Each spot counts twice if you meditate there with both Jason and Lucia, and progress is tracked under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. THE ONE TO NOT MISS: in Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate and walks to the balcony. Follow her, choose Accept, and she teaches you to meditate. That session is gone for good after Chapter 1, and PowerPyx reports it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it — the safe move is to do it. The last spot only opens once you can play both characters together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 meditations are needed, so this trophy asks for more than the checklist does.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret), in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive it, so this strand is Jason-only. Bret hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker) and marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. A clean one-shot kill leaves the animal pristine and pays more, but is not required. Which exact animal pops the trophy is still being confirmed at launch, per PowerPyx; work through his Target Decks — all 15 are needed for the 100% checklist anyway — and it will come.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets — you do not need all of them. Cards are found across Leonida; PowerPyx lists all 18 set locations, and GTABase notes a few magazine collectibles sit in story buildings that later become inaccessible, but they also spawn elsewhere, so nothing is locked out. The 100% checklist asks for 15 of 18 sets, so this silver pops early on the way to that much bigger ask.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the phone app: hold Up to open WAiNK, look at a scannable object and hold R1. The locations split into 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags — more than 100 in total, so any 100 will do. Scan as you travel and it builds up passively; the 100% checklist needs the same 100, so this silver and that checklist line finish together.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges in the game (the 100% checklist needs 70, so this pops on the way). View them under Progress > Challenges — a checkmark in the bottom right shows what is done. Most complete naturally while you work on the other trophies; when you are down to the last few, pick the easiest remaining ones and skip the hardest, since there are 30 to spare.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Earliest chance is after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can free-roam with your partner — call them with Right + Triangle. Build a 4-star wanted level (cause carnage until the stars climb), then escape the red heat zone entirely; the trophy pops when you drive out of it, not when you leave the flashing search area. Easiest route, per PowerPyx: a fast sports motorcycle through the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops struggle to follow and the helicopter cannot see you. It also pops naturally in Chapter 4's optional mission That's Where The Money Is…, since robbing large bank vaults always triggers 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside (available after Chapter 2's Coffee Break), rob 3 shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time — keep the flashing red/blue wanted level and never let it clear. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix/Adrenaline for healing (Ammu-Nation sells them). A good spot, per PowerPyx: the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — loot a couple of items in each and break the back-room safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after leaving the third shop; if it does not come, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles out of the 557 in the game. The fast way: open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles as they pass — stand on a busy road and hold R1 on each new one. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive them. Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. The 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so keep scanning past 100 and this bronze pops on the way.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: While aiming a firearm, press L3 + R3 to trigger Combat Focus — time slows and vulnerable spots are highlighted — then drop 5 enemies before the purple focus bar runs out. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so use criminals at gang operations. Prepare first: eat or drink (or wash up at home) to buff focus, carry Adrenaline to extend it (hold L1, press Triangle), wear body armor from Ammu-Nation, and use a full-auto rifle like the Duke 556 for accuracy. Focus has 4 levels, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots — by late game you will likely be at level 4 and may earn this naturally.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be one connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not a plane parked on the airfield. Easiest, per PowerPyx: the plane at terminals E3/E4. Drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, use the stairs by the boarding bridge to get in, go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the airstrip and take off. Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport and the trophy pops — the unlock is slightly delayed, so keep flying.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank (a Rhino) and use it until the trophy pops. The tanks are at Mile Zero Air Station, the island on the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County — they stand in the south of the base. Drive through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb in and shoot some enemies. Expect heavy resistance getting in and out, so bring armor and a fast getaway vehicle parked outside.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish Chapter 3's Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks jewelry store robberies and the Snap Gun, which silently lockpicks alarmed doors and stays in your inventory. Pick a store (they are marked with a green icon once the area is unfogged), go in through the back door and choose the Snap Gun instead of kicking the door, which would trip the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. PowerPyx recommends Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City as a clean spot.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape each time. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe), which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry the briefcase in and open the vault, slip in and grab the cash — bring your partner, since you cannot carry it all alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that, pay Yasmani $10,000 per tip (once you have done his Payday Loans jobs) to mark security vans with a purple icon. Each vault robbery triggers a 4-star wanted level instantly, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch cars to break recognition. The 100% checklist needs all 8 vaults, so this silver pops on the way, and each vault can pay up to $205,000.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the red heat radius (or duck into a Pay 'n' Spray). The easy path is the same Chapter 4 mission as Maximum Withdrawal — That's Where The Money Is… — since tailing the security van to a bank vault counts as robbing an armored truck. Earlier method, per PowerPyx: find an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open — sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his jobs. Either way the trophy only pops after you escape the heat.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fully unfog the whole map — all 52 areas of Leonida. The fast way, per PowerPyx, is by plane: fly over every black-fogged patch until the map is visible. Do it late, after the story, when the whole state is open and you have a plane; check the map as you go and mop up the last fogged corners on foot or by car. It pairs well with scanning vehicles and WAiNK locations while you fly and drive around.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs — there are 39 operations in total, marked with yellow icons on the map when you get near them, and many are marked automatically from story progress. Always loot every key valuable at a site (hover its icon to see what is left) or it may not count as cleared. The 100% checklist needs all 39 cleared, so this bronze pops early on that grind; track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as currently unknown (19 Nov 2026). The description itself is the only lead: go to a bar on Ocean Beach and order a cocktail somewhere with a view of the water. Try the beachfront bars in the Ocean Beach area once the map is open; if one does not pop it, try another spot along the beach. We will update this guide when a source confirms the exact location — do not trust any walkthrough that claims a specific bar without a source.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — PowerPyx lists this trophy's trigger as currently unknown (19 Nov 2026). The description points the way: drive a car out through the glass front of a vehicle showroom, in the style of the classic GTA showroom escape. Try the dealership showrooms around Vice City once you have a car inside or can drive one through the front; the pop, if it works like the older games, comes as you smash out onto the street. Treat any specific showroom named elsewhere as unconfirmed until a second source agrees.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn — a gang operation, not a game of bowling. It is marked automatically during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. Bring sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation first: the 3 valuables are a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing the enemies is not required. If you miss an item during the mission, wait for the robbery icon to respawn and go back for what is left — it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Strength is checked under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select a character > Strength (heart icon). You can only start after Chapter 2's Coffee Break, when you can switch between the two. Work out at a fitness club — buy a membership, and always bring your partner along (hold Right + Triangle to call them): while one character trains, the other completes their training too, so you progress twice as fast. Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon); there are clubs all over Vice City, and you can also work out at home after the story.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile — the game counts them, and you can see the running total by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on profile notifications first (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On): a small demon face appears on the right of the screen whenever an action counts. What counts ranges from finishing objectives and robberies cleanly (Professional) to incapacitating enemies (Hardened), killing (Violent), mass killing (Psycho) and, if you go too far, Irredeemable — which is permanent and makes cops shoot on sight, so avoid farming with excessive violence. It happens passively while you work on the other trophies; every robbery and enemy encounter counts.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue (19 Nov 2026). The name suggests failing at something once and succeeding on the second try. The honest advice for now: play the Prologue's Payday Loans content, and if a robbery or job there fails, retry it immediately rather than reloading an old save. Do not chase this one early — revisit it once a source confirms the trigger.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline (19 Nov 2026). The description reads like a reaction to something strange in the world, which fits a UFO sighting or encounter. Keep an eye on the skies at night in remote areas of Leonida and on any stranger quests that mention strange lights; as with the other unknowns, wait for a confirmed trigger before going out of your way for it.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED AT LAUNCH — PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle (19 Nov 2026). The name and description both point the same way: a melee attack from a moving vehicle that knocks someone down like a bowling pin. The working method is to ride a motorbike slowly past a pedestrian and kick them with a melee attack as you pass. Treat that as a theory, not a confirmed method, until a second source agrees.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through a fence — it counts across all robberies, not in one trip. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder the bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans, and bring the marked bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. Bank vaults are the big earner, up to $205,000 in a single robbery, but they only open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. It comes naturally while you do the robbery trophies for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shop types — the counter is cumulative, so normal play covers most of it. The fastest way to finish it off is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, and tattoos. There are 14 mod shops, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair & beauty salons, 11 tattoo studios and 15 electronics stores, per PowerPyx — spend where you were going to spend anyway, and check the trophy total when you are close.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages (there are 4 more story-related garages that do not count). They cost $160,000 in total and become available after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses), when the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone — buy them through that app. Robberies are the quickest way to earn the money, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4. Garages also add parking spots, which the On the Spot trophy needs.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app, which is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) and lets you call registered vehicles to your location. First buy enough garages (see Little Boxes) — each garage adds parking spots to register more vehicles. Then drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register in his garage. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with Standard Trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registration costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
